comment: Known abc routes and gaps. Edges are not proofs. The target is lean/Abc/Statement.lean. This graph is context for the proof-attempt loop, not evidence.

abc_statement.note: Masser-Oesterle abc; frozen in lean/Abc/Statement.lean. No proof exists in this repository.

definitions.note: Abc.rad, Abc.quality, Abc.Statement, Abc.FinitelyMany. Only rad_one is proved.

mason_stothers.note: Polynomial abc; Mathlib has Polynomial.abc. It is an analogue and does not imply integer abc.

szpiro.note: Szpiro's conjecture; equivalent to abc over Q (standard). Not formalized here.

stewart_yu.note: Explicit weaker bound for coprime triples; not the full 1+epsilon statement.

gyory_yu.note: S-unit and linear-forms bounds; partial results, not abc.

iut.note: Inter-universal Teichmuller theory; claimed proof not accepted by the field.
